rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 111, Line 1a: "If the advance credit payments were more than the premium tax credit you can claim, the amount you must repay will be shown on Form 8962, line 29. Enter that amount, if any, on line 1a"; i8962 p. 3, Who Must File (Form 8962 only with a Form 1095-A or advance payments). The project enters zero when no Form 1095-A is listed; the candidate copies Form 8962 line 29 on every return, so a filer with no Marketplace coverage must answer Form 8962's questions (f8962.alloc) and reach its household income. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/s2.json`; 1,372 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 80 partial records; 1,952 comparisons): 603 of 1,952 agree; 889 candidate-unknown (489 on completed returns, for example witnesses 0-5 classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .6.deepseek, project $0.00); 460 candidate-refuses, all on refused returns (witnesses 6-11, for example classm.w2.1.deepseek, classm.f8889.2.deepseek: refusals reached through Form 8962's household income); no value differs. The published interface offers the f1095a count, so the guard was expressible. Same ruling as Stage 18 and round 1. Project stands.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Both are zero within scope (the alternative minimum tax is refused through s2.amt); the second copies the zero parameter sales.zero where the project writes the constant 0.

Ruling: scope; the project refuses alternative minimum tax through the computed screen s2.amt (Form 6251 refusal on line 2; this round adds the Schedule 1 line 8a net operating loss deduction, Form 6251 line 2e, to its line 4 estimate, s2.amt_l4_sum) and enters zero otherwise; the reply figures Form 6251 itself with its own refusals. Triage (pass 4d367142f549) 2,550/3,238 agree with no value difference anywhere: on completed returns 208 candidate-unknown (the reply reads Form 6251 inputs the interview does not ask, e.g. s2.amt_boat) and 2 candidate-refuses; the rest are on refused or incomplete records (171 project-refuses at s2.amt). f1040s2 line 2; i6251 Who Must File. As in the Goal-1 round.

Ruling: scope; f1040s2 line 2, 'See the Instructions for Form 6251 to see if you must file the form', as the ruling of 2026-11-17: the project refuses the alternative minimum tax through its computed s2.amt screen and enters zero otherwise; the reply figures Form 6251 where the project refuses. executable triage (.transcription/triage/2025/s2.json, this pass): 2,855/3,509 agree; differences {"candidate-refuses": 85, "candidate-unknown": 409, "project-refuses": 150, "project-unknown": 10}; on completed returns {"candidate-refuses": 52, "candidate-unknown": 158}; no value differs on a completed return. Rerun for the s2.amt_business and s2.amt_pab wording (BUG-0946, BUG-0980).

Ruling: scope; f1040s2 line 2 and i6251 Who Must File. The project does not figure the alternative minimum tax: line 2 is $0 and refuses (Form 6251) when the computed screen s2.amt may be true (docs/2026-11-15_amt_computed_screen.md); the reply computes Form 6251 inline with its own refusals. Triage (pass fbc614250ee5): 2,411/2,922 agree; no value difference; completed: 55 candidate-unknown (the reply reads s2.amt_business and s2.amt_boat, asked only under their parents) and 28 candidate-refuses (the reply's own scope, e.g. the AMT foreign tax credit, s2.h_has_ftc); the rest on incomplete or refused records. The screen itself is not ruled here.

Ruling: model error on the declaration, ruled mechanically: the reply fails the host's schema, type or reference validation on this line or a line it reads (s2.h_amt_l13: "s2.s2.h_amt_l13: declared NonNegDollars but the expression does not prove non-negativity"), so the line was not executed. This adjudicates the declaration, not the tax reading.

Ruling: scope; f1040s2 p. 112, Line 2, "See the Instructions for Form 6251 to see if you must file the form". The project refuses alternative minimum tax through the computed s2.amt screen and enters zero otherwise; the reply figures Form 6251 where the project refuses, and the differences are those refusals. Triage executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/s2.json): 2741 of 3472 comparisons agree, 1862 of 2290 in scope; completed {"candidate-refuses": 50, "candidate-unknown": 280}. Project stands.
Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Lines 1z and 2 are both zero within scope (s2.other and s2.amt refuse them); the second copies the zero parameter where the project writes the constant 0.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Line 3 is "Add lines 1z and 2" (f1040s2 p. 1, line 3); line 1z is zero within scope because every line 1 item is refused by s2.other ("Any amount on Schedule 2 other than self-employment tax from Schedule SE, Additional Medicare Tax or Net Investment Income Tax"), and line 2 is zero because the alternative minimum tax is refused by s2.amt. The second copies line 2, which is zero, where the project writes the constant 0, as ruled before.

Ruling: model error; the line is the screening question whose label lists what counts as another amount, including "household employment taxes" and "uncollected social security or Medicare tax on tips or group-term life insurance (W-2 box 12 codes A, B, M or N)" (i1040gi p. 113, Lines 9 and 13); the reply's test leaves out those two answers (s2.household_employee_if_help, s2.w2_marks_if_w2), so as a gate for the readers that rely on it (s8812 line 22, "Schedule 2 lines 5, 6 and 13 are refused by s2.other"; tipjob; s1a) it would not refuse them, and it reads the ungated s2.mortgage_subsidy and s2.lookback where the project reads their parent-gated forms. Triage executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/s2.json, pass 19839a055a94): 2,740 of 2,868 agree; no value difference in the sample (no sampled return answers Yes to the two omitted questions); 61 candidate-unknown (15 on completed returns, s2.mortgage_subsidy or s2.lookback unasked behind their parent questions), 67 project-unknown on incomplete or refused returns.

Ruling: model error; as the earlier rulings: s2.other is the project's screen ('Any amount on Schedule 2 other than the following?', the lines this tool figures), which the IRS pages do not define, as the reply says; its reading 'line 21 above zero' would refuse or flag every return with self-employment tax, Additional Medicare Tax or net investment income tax, which the tool computes (the 273 completed value differences of triage, for example stage14.asset.hy_5yr with line 21 $6,980 of SE tax). Executable triage (.transcription/triage/2025/s2.json, this pass): 2,035/3,645 agree. Rerun because the look-back operand s2.lookback_if_business now chooses on s2.lookback_ask (Schedule C or a business before 2025, BUG-1092).

Ruling: model error; s2.other is the project's screen for Schedule 2 amounts the tool does not figure (its label lists the ones it does: Schedule SE, Additional Medicare Tax, NIIT and the Form 8889 line 17b tax), so it is true only when one of the named screens is Yes. The reply reads it as 'line 21 above zero', which is true for every return with self-employment tax (the stage14.asset fixtures, a Schedule C with SE tax), giving the 221 value differences in the executable triage (s2.json, this pass). The line changed only by s2.lookback_ask's royalty leg (BUG-1332). Project stands.

Ruling: model error; as the earlier rulings of this line: s2.other is the project's screen ('Any amount on Schedule 2 other than the following?', the lines this tool figures), which the IRS pages do not define, as the reply says; its reading 'line 21 above zero' would refuse or flag every return with self-employment tax, Additional Medicare Tax or net investment income tax, which the tool computes. The line changed only through s2.lookback_ask's royalty leg, now read through s2.lookback_royalty (a choice on scope.rental) with the same value for every known answer (BUG-1448). Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 113, Lines 9 and 13 (household employment taxes; uncollected social security and Medicare tax on W-2 box 12 codes A, B, M, N). As in the landing round: the reply's screen for Schedule 2 amounts the tool does not figure leaves out s2.household_employee and s2.w2_marks (both in its input list), so the line other forms rely on (s8812 line 22, s1a, tipjob) would not refuse a Schedule H or uncollected-tax return. It also reads s2.mortgage_subsidy and s2.lookback raw (the project asks them only of a home owner and of a Schedule C filer). Triage (pass fbc614250ee5): 2,669/2,922 agree; no value in the bank; completed: 35 candidate-unknown (s2.mortgage_subsidy not asked); 218 candidate-/project-unknown on incomplete or refused records.
